resources.mode_dialog_title: How should runs use this folder?
resources.mode_dialog_description: This decides how you get an agent's work back, and whether runs on this folder can execute at the same time.
resources.mode_in_place_description: One run at a time. Changes appear in your working copy as the agent makes them, ready for you to keep working on.
resources.mode_worktree_description: Runs execute at the same time without touching your working copy. Each one hands back an agent/… branch in this repo for you to review and merge.
resources.mode_worktree_needs_git: This folder is not a git repository, so there is nowhere to put the branch. Pick a repository, or keep editing the folder directly.
resources.mode_worktree_needs_server_upgrade: Your Multica server is too old to execute runs in parallel — it would quietly execute them in this folder instead. Update the server, then switch this on.
resources.mode_edit_tooltip: Change how runs use this folder
resources.mode_badge_worktree_tooltip: Runs execute at the same time in their own git worktree and hand back a branch. Your working copy is untouched.
resources.toast_local_mode_update_failed: Could not update the execution mode
resources.ref_hint: Tasks start from this branch and open their pull requests against it. Leave empty to use the repository's default branch.
resources.ref_error_characters: A git ref can't contain spaces or any of ~ ^ : ? * [ \
resources.ref_error_format: Not a valid branch, tag, or commit.
resources.ref_dialog_title: Which branch should tasks work on?
resources.ref_dialog_description: New tasks in this project check out this branch and open their pull requests against it. Work already underway keeps the branch it started on.
resources.ref_edit_tooltip: Change the branch tasks work on
resources.ref_badge_tooltip: Tasks start from {{ref}} and deliver back to it.
resources.ref_error_commit: That's a commit, not a branch. Tasks deliver back to the branch they start from — for a one-off revision, pass --ref to multica repo checkout.
resources.ref_default_tooltip: No branch set — tasks use whatever the repository's default branch is at the time.

delete_dialog.title: Delete project
delete_dialog.description: This will delete the project. Issues will not be deleted but will be unlinked.

intro.title: Break big work into projects
intro.description: A project groups related issues so you can track them together. Its description and linked repositories go along as context on every agent run.

progress.title: See progress at a glance
progress.description: Status, lead, target date, and completion sit on one card, so you don't have to open every issue.

context.title: Context travels with every run
context.description: Write the description and link repositories once. Every run on the project's issues picks them up.

sidebar.title: Pinned to your sidebar
sidebar.description: Pin the projects you use most to the sidebar, and expand one to see its issues.
